---
title: Server upload
toc: false
---

Send your recordings to a server you run. Voicenotes keeps a copy on your watch.

## Set up the receiver

1. Set `VOICENOTES_TOKEN` to a random ASCII token of at least 32 characters. Keep the same token across restarts.
2. From the repository folder, run `python server/receiver.py --data data` with Python 3.11 or newer.
3. Put a reverse proxy with a trusted HTTPS certificate in front of `127.0.0.1:8787`. Use an address your watch or paired phone can reach.
4. In Garmin Connect, open the Voicenotes app settings. Enter the base address in **Server URL (HTTPS)** and the token in **Server access token**.

## Upload a note

1. Open a recording in **Saved notes**.
2. Press **MENU** or **DOWN**, then choose **Upload**.
3. Look for **Uploaded** in **Saved notes**. On your server, each recording has its own folder under `data` with the audio file and `metadata.json`.

Back up the server’s `data` folder to keep a copy of your uploads.

To send new recordings automatically, turn on **Automatically upload queued notes (also in background)** in Garmin Connect.

If you want to include GPS coordinates, turn on **Save location** in **Saved notes** before recording. The upload includes coordinates if your watch gets a GPS fix during the recording.

[Get notified about new uploads in Home Assistant](how-to/home-assistant-notifications.qmd)
